subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & PO handling for Papertrail Logistics
messages:
From: Kelly Barnes <kelly@papertraillogistics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoicing method question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the onboarding for Papertrail Logistics (vendor code: PTL-0042) and have a couple of operational questions before we complete the vendor form. Our AP team prefers to send consolidated PDF invoices by email to a central address, but your onboarding guide references a portal with subject-token-based acknowledgements.

Two quick asks:
- Is the portal mandatory for capturing PO stamping and automated 3-way match, or can we use the email fallback with specific subject tokens and a CSV attachment?
- If email fallback is acceptable, can you share a compact CSV sample for line items and how PO references should appear (single PO per file vs PO column per line)?

I've attached our partially filled onboarding form and a sample consolidated invoice we typically send (PDF). Appreciate a short note on the recommended path — we have an early-pay discount proposal that depends on timely acknowledgement.

Best,
Kelly Barnes
Vendor Ops Lead
Papertrail Logistics
Attachments: papertrail_onboarding_form_v2.xlsx (xlsx), consolidated_invoice_0625.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Barnes <kelly@papertraillogistics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoicing method question

Hi Kelly — thanks for the attachments, they helped. Short answer: portal-first, email fallback OK with constraints.

Portal benefits (recommended):
- Automated PO stamping, idempotency, and faster acks that trigger AP routing.
- Better parsing for multi-PO invoices; you can upload a single CSV that includes a PO column per line.

Email fallback constraints (when portal not possible):
- Subject must contain: REDWOOD_ACK_TOKEN=<unique-token> and COMPANY_PO=<po_number> (we use this to map to the right ledger).
- Attachments: a compact CSV for line items (sample attached) OR a PDF plus a one-line CSV summary. PDFs rely on OCR and increase manual review.
- For multi-PO invoices include a PO column on each line; avoid stacking multiple POs into a single free-text field.

I've attached a sample CSV (sample_invoice_rows.csv) and a one-paragraph template vendors can paste in the email body for quicker acks. Vanessa/Kimberly — fyi on the early-pay discount ask; can AP support an exception for a 7-day pay discount conditional on inbound token acks?

Jonas
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_invoice_rows.csv (csv)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoicing method question

Thanks for the summary, Jonas. A few procurement/AP notes (gap-analysis style):

1) PO stamping: portal handles stamping automatically. For email fallback our downstream ERP needs an explicit PO column per line; if Papertrail sends consolidated PDFs without a CSV we will have to place the invoice into a manual-queue, delaying payment and voiding early-pay discounts.

2) Token/ack lifecycle: our inbox processes tokens to generate a 1-line ack within 2 hours. If vendors use the subject token and include CSV, the ack will consider the invoice received and eligible for early-pay if PO match succeeds within 7 days. If OCR/manual review required, early-pay can't be promised.

3) Edge cases: multi-entity POs (if Papertrail invoices multiple Redwood entities) require entity_code column on CSV or separate emails per entity. Also flag tax lines per row — we need a tax_type column (VAT/withholding).

Action requested from Jonas: approve a one-time exception to accept consolidated PDFs for the first 2 months (manual review) while we onboard them to the portal. If approved, I'll allocate a manual-review queue and estimate a 3–5 day SLA for the first month.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoicing method question

Kelly — good talking point. Finalized path below and next steps: 

Decision (portal-first; email fallback permitted with constraints):
- Portal: preferred. Please register at https://portal.redwood.com/vendors and upload the onboarding form we received (we filled some fields). That will enable automatic PO stamping and idempotent uploads.
- Email fallback: allowed temporarily. Please use the subject line format: REDWOOD_ACK_TOKEN=PTL-<unique> COMPANY_PO=<po_number>. Attach sample_invoice_rows.csv for line-level detail. If you must send consolidated PDFs, include a one-line CSV (invoice summary) as a separate attachment to avoid OCR delays.
- Multi-entity: include entity_code column in CSV per line if invoicing multiple Redwood entities.
- Early-pay discount: Procurement approved a conditional pilot — 7-day 0.5% discount for the first two invoices if: (a) email subject contains the REDWOOD_ACK_TOKEN, (b) CSV attached, and (c) PO matches automatically. Manual-review cases will be excluded.

Attachments: I've attached our annotated onboarding form (papertrail_onboarding_form_v2.xlsx) and a blank token-generation guide (see link). Once you upload to the portal we can auto-provision a vendor token. If you want, Vanessa will run a quick pilot on a single invoice to confirm the flow this week.

Next steps:
- Kelly: upload onboarding form to portal OR send email with subject token and CSV (sample attached).
- Vanessa: provision manual-queue for the pilot and confirm SLA.
- Kimberly/Jordan: if there are ERP mapping questions, loop in AP integrator (cc'd).

Thanks — looking forward to getting Papertrail live.

Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
